title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations on distinct Long Beach corridors within the practical orbit of CSULB, each paired with one verified reason to stop.

cards.title: Take a Recreation Break at Whaley Park
cards.subtitle: Atherton Street, directly north of CSULB
cards.notes: Cross Atherton Street for a break among the picnic areas, courts, athletic fields, playgrounds, and other park amenities.
cards.short_summary: A campus-adjacent recreation stop with several choices for an active or low-key break.
cards.evidence_claim: The City says Whaley Park is adjacent to CSULB and has athletic fields, courts, picnic areas, playgrounds, and restrooms.
cards.access_notes: The city page lists recreation-center hours of Monday through Friday, 2:30–5:30 p.m.; park-area rules apply.

cards.title: Build a Meal on Bellflower Boulevard
cards.subtitle: Bellflower Boulevard, northwest of campus
cards.notes: Stop at the Bellflower Boulevard market when you need prepared food, bakery items, coffee, juice, or groceries in one trip.
cards.short_summary: A nearby market combining groceries with several made-to-order and prepared-food counters.
cards.evidence_claim: Lazy Acres lists its Long Beach store at 2080 N. Bellflower Blvd. with an in-house bakery, prepared foods, coffee and juice, and multiple food bars.
cards.access_notes: The official store page lists daily hours of 6 a.m.–10 p.m.; purchases are required for food or merchandise.

cards.entity_name: Rancho Los Alamitos Historic Ranch & Gardens
cards.title: Enter the Rancho from Anaheim Road
cards.subtitle: East Anaheim Road at Palo Verde Avenue, beside campus
cards.notes: Use the signed residential gate at Anaheim and Palo Verde, then follow the route to the ranch house, gardens, and animals.
cards.short_summary: A public historic ranch reached through a clearly documented entrance immediately east of CSULB.
cards.evidence_claim: Rancho Los Alamitos directs visitors to enter at East Anaheim Road and Palo Verde Avenue and offers history, gardens, animals, and free admission.
cards.access_notes: Enter through the Bixby Hill gate at Anaheim Road and Palo Verde Avenue; tell the attendant you are visiting the Rancho.

cards.title: Pause for Coffee on Norse Way
cards.subtitle: Norse Way in Lakewood Village
cards.notes: Head to the Norse Way storefront for coffee during a Lakewood Village errand loop, checking the posted schedule before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A named independent coffee stop anchoring the compact Norse Way business corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Wolf's Brew Coffee lists its address as 4145 Norse Way and publishes operating hours on its official website.
cards.access_notes: The official site lists Monday–Friday 8 a.m.–5 p.m. and Saturday–Sunday 8 a.m.–4 p.m.

cards.title: Order Pizza on Los Coyotes Diagonal
cards.subtitle: Los Coyotes Diagonal in East Long Beach
cards.notes: Use the Los Coyotes location—not the separate Retro Row shop—when pizza fits an off-campus lunch or early-evening plan.
cards.short_summary: A clearly identified pizza destination directly on the diagonal corridor northeast of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Little Coyote's official site identifies its Los Coyotes location at 3500 N. Los Coyotes Diagonal and publishes weekday hours.
cards.source_title: Little Coyote: Long Beach Pizza Shop & More
cards.access_notes: The official site lists the Los Coyotes location Monday–Friday, noon–9 p.m.; verify before a weekend trip.

cards.title: Follow the Trails off Spring Street
cards.subtitle: Spring Street at the San Gabriel River
cards.notes: Enter from Spring Street, cross the wooden bridge, and choose the paved quarter-mile route or the longer dirt trails.
cards.short_summary: A trail-and-lake destination that turns the Spring Street corridor into a nature excursion.
cards.evidence_claim: The City describes a 105-acre habitat at El Dorado Nature Center with two miles of dirt trails, a quarter-mile paved trail, lakes, a stream, and a visitor center.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists daily vehicle-parking charges; consult posted trail and service-dog rules before visiting.

cards.title: Photograph the Marina-Facing Center
cards.subtitle: Pacific Coast Highway at Second Street
cards.notes: Use the center's visitor guidance to photograph its public-facing spaces, while respecting restricted and private areas.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed shopping center where the official visitor page expressly addresses guest photography.
cards.evidence_claim: 2ND & PCH lists its address as 6480 East Pacific Coast Highway and states that photography is encouraged subject to its guidelines.
cards.access_notes: Center hours are listed as Monday–Saturday 10 a.m.–9 p.m. and Sunday 11 a.m.–7 p.m.; photography guidelines apply.

cards.title: Choose a Sport on Seventh Street
cards.subtitle: East Seventh Street west of campus
cards.notes: Arrive from Seventh Street and choose among the picnic area, playground, courts, casting pond, community center, or fields.
cards.short_summary: A large civic recreation complex that supports several different kinds of daytime outings.
cards.evidence_claim: The City locates Recreation Park at 4900 E. 7th St. and lists amenities including a casting pond, playground, picnic area, tennis center, fields, and community center.
cards.access_notes: Some facilities, classes, golf, and reserved picnic uses have separate contacts or fees; check the city page before planning them.

cards.title: Use the Library on Britton Drive
cards.subtitle: Britton Drive in Los Altos
cards.notes: Bring a device for the free Wi-Fi or use a public computer, and check the branch calendar if you want to pair the stop with an event.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood-library stop with connectivity, computers, accessible facilities, and bike parking.
cards.evidence_claim: The City locates Los Altos Neighborhood Library at 5614 E. Britton Dr. and lists public computers, free Wi-Fi, accessible facilities, and a bike rack.
cards.access_notes: The branch is closed Sunday and Monday; the official page lists Tuesday–Saturday hours that vary by day.

cards.title: Catch an Independent Film on Fourth Street
cards.subtitle: East Fourth Street on Retro Row
cards.notes: Check the current calendar before heading to the Fourth Street marquee, since films, discussions, and special programs rotate.
cards.short_summary: A historic independent cinema that gives the Fourth Street corridor a specific cultural destination.
cards.evidence_claim: The Art Theatre identifies its location at 2025 E. 4th St. and describes itself as an independent Long Beach cinema operating since the 1920s.
cards.access_notes: Screenings and program times vary; consult the official calendar and ticket details before traveling.
